pages.text: Logistics networks require maintenance. Sometimes a hauler might get interrupted, or you might want to repurpose an old destination. Knowing how a dock behaves is vital to avoid jams.

pages.title: Dock States
pages.text: $(a)Free (Green):$() Ready to receive incoming haulers.$(br)$(e)Reserved (Yellow):$() A hauler is en route to this dock. Locked for others.$(br)$(c)Occupied (Red):$() Currently holding a landed shipment.$(br)$(8)Inaccessible (Gray):$() Airspace blocked or dock destroyed.

pages.title: Unsticking a Dock
pages.text: If a hauler crashes or data gets desynced, a dock might remain locked in 'Reserved' status. Simply $(2)Shift + Right-Click$() with an $(2)Empty Hand$() on the dock to force-reset it and clear the network.

pages.title: Remember
pages.text: Always remember to keep a $(2)3x3 clear vertical area$() above your docks. If blocks are placed in its flight path post-setup, incoming haulers will abort landing, enter an emergency state, and wait for your intervention.
